annotation.summary_en: Excerpt from the 2002 Official Journal (C 87 E) with European Parliament texts of 4 October 2001: amendments to a terrorist asset-freezing regulation, approval of the joint text on general product safety, and a resolution on the post-9/11 extraordinary European Council. No AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament amendments to asset-freezing regulation: 'reasonable suspicion' standard, sunset 31 December 2003
Parliament approves Conciliation Committee joint text on general product safety directive
Resolution on extraordinary European Council of 21 September 2001 following 9/11 attacks
